title: Arc-AGI 3 benchmark scores released for frontier models
summary: New Arc-AGI 3 benchmark scores were published. Reported figures include GPT 5.5 around 0.4%, Opus 4.6 max around 0.5%, and Opus 4.7 around 0.2%, underlining that frontier models still solve only a small fraction of the benchmark.
